preconditions.description: The number of crimes n must be between 0 and 10^18.
The number of conditions c must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi for mi in multiplicities)
preconditions.description: All multiplicities must be positive integers.
The number of unique crime types must not exceed 26.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways Zeyad can commit exactly n crimes without punishment modulo 12345.
